assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: high-frequency poker card-back game texture, final file card-back.png.
Input image 1 is the existing brand logo reference: an ivory playing-card silhouette, a tiny green spade at upper-left, and two simple dark crescent CLOSED eyelids. Use this exact sleepy identity for the small central emblem.
Primary request: A premium yet cute flat-vector poker card BACK pattern. Deep green #227865 base covers the entire playing card. In the center, a SMALL ivory #F5EEDF sleepy playing-card emblem, with two closed dark-navy crescent eyes and a tiny green spade. Around it, a balanced symmetrical pattern of delicate geometric gold linework: diamonds, intersecting angular lines and fine ornamental corner motifs, evenly distributed across the entire green card face. A thin gold #E5C17A inset perimeter frame follows the rounded rectangular card shape.
Composition: ONE straight upright portrait playing-card back, exact 5:7 card aspect ratio, target 500x700. Orthographic flat front view of the back; no tilt, no perspective, no thickness. The card fills the image edge to edge, with only genuinely transparent pixels OUTSIDE its rounded corners. No surrounding whitespace or display margins. The fine geometric pattern fills the card face, not a blank green border. Central sleepy emblem remains small, roughly 18% of card width, so ornament dominates.
Style: crisp flat vector-style illustration with solid fills and clean fine lines, readable when downscaled. Palette only #07111B, #F5EEDF, #227865, #E5C17A.
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, rank labels, watermark, mockup, props, 3D, gradients, shadows or texture. One complete card-back texture only. Transparent outside rounded corners; fully opaque green within the card.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: home screen hero illustration, final file home-hero.png.
Input image 1 is the established sleepy playing-card brand character. Preserve its ivory rounded playing-card body, tiny green spade in upper-left, and two simple dark-navy crescent CLOSED eyelids. Add simple small navy limbs to anthropomorphize it; no glasses and no human face.
Primary request: A small serene poker-table scene for a relaxing poker learning app. A deep green elliptical poker table seen from a high overhead view, its long axis horizontal, with a midnight-navy rim and a restrained thin gold trim. ONE cute sleepy ivory playing-card character sits comfortably at the upper edge of the table, eyes peacefully closed, little arms resting on the edge. On the tabletop are just a few neatly arranged poker chips and TWO face-up ivory playing cards with simple green spade symbols, without ranks, numbers or letters. The character feels companionable and calm.
Composition: wide 2:1 canvas, target 1200x600. A complete compact scene, centered and composed specifically for a short wide UI card. The oval table is broad and horizontal; character rises just above its far edge and is clearly recognizable. Keep the entire table, character and all props inside the frame with about 6% fully transparent breathing room; no cropping. Overhead / high-angle view with very shallow depth, simple readable shapes.
Mood and style: quiet relaxed night atmosphere expressed through restrained dark navy, green and warm ivory/gold, with no background scenery. Crisp flat vector-style illustration, clean rounded geometry, mostly solid color blocks, consistent thin dark outlines. No photographic texture, gradients or 3D rendering.
Palette: dark navy #07111B, ivory #F5EEDF, green #227865, gold #E5C17A only.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha all around the isolated scene, no colored backdrop, vignette, rectangle, stars, landscape or floor.
Constraints: no text, no lettering, no numerals, no watermark, no logos other than the character's spade. One character, one table, a few chips and exactly two open cards.

assets.refinement:
Use case: background-extraction
Input image 1 is the edit target. Preserve the exact sleepy playing-card character, blank open notebook, hand and leg poses, proportions, spade, closed eyelids, all colors, and the composition.
Change ONLY the surrounding background / edge treatment: remove ALL gray/white haze, glow, halo, drop shadow, ambient shadow, and color bloom surrounding the character. All pixels outside the crisp outlines of the card character, book, hands and feet must be fully transparent alpha=0, including the spaces inside the arms. Make a clean isolated transparent PNG cutout suitable for placing on BOTH white and dark UI backgrounds, with only normal 1-pixel edge antialiasing and no soft halo.
Keep flat vector-style solid fills, no new shading or gradients. Keep the little notebook pages completely blank. Landscape 3:2, target 600x400, centered complete subject with safe clear padding. No text or extra elements.
